title: regional-tiered-circuit-and-shed-coordinator-hotfix
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Backported a stability fix for regional circuit state churn and staged load-shedding coordination. Improves circuit reopen hysteresis and persists transient backoff state to KV so short-lived egress spikes don't cause tenant starvation. No API changes.
description:
Summary: Fix a production issue where brief egress spikes in a region triggered rapid circuit reopen/close cycles and aggressive tenant-level shedding that led to sustained tail latency and partial outages for multi-tenant workloads. This PR introduces a tiered circuit state machine, a probation TTL for reopen attempts, a lightweight per-tenant hysteresis counter, and durable transient backoff persisted to the local KV snapshot to avoid flip loops after process restarts.

Motivation and root cause: During a short-lived network egress blip in us-west we observed that the previous coordinator logic would immediately consider a probe-success as a full circuit reopen. That caused traffic to return to already-saturated nodes which tripped circuits again, creating rapid flips and aggressive per-tenant shedding. Because transient backoff state was only in-memory, a restart (rolling deploy or crash) would lose the brief cooldown window and restart the flip loop.

What I changed: - Introduced a 3-tier circuit state: CLOSED, PROBATION, OPEN. PROBATION is a short TTL window after which the circuit either moves to CLOSED (if probes/stats are healthy) or returns to OPEN with increased penalty. - Added per-tenant hysteresis counters that require N consecutive successful probe/latency windows before fully removing shedding weights; counters are bounded and decay over time. - Persisted a compact transient backoff snapshot to the runtime KV store (eviction-safe, TTL'd) so short restarts do not immediately reset penalties. - Adjusted staged shedding logic: we now ramp tenant weights in small steps (configurable) instead of single-step toggles. - Added new metrics: circuit_probation_entries, tenant_hysteresis_events, kv_backoff_snapshot_hits; enhanced logging around state transitions for easier incident postmortems. - Covered new state transitions with unit tests and a small integration harness that simulates short regional egress spikes.

Files changed (high level): see changed_files field below for full list. Key areas: runtime/shed/coordination.go (state machine), runtime/shed/kv_backoff_snapshot.go (kv persistence), routing/region_failover.go (probe semantics), observability/metrics/slo_metrics.go (new counters), runtime/shed/coordinator_test.go (unit tests), deploy/helm/values.yaml (default probation TTL tuned).

Testing and validation: - Unit tests added for state transitions and hysteresis counter decay. - Integration harness simulates 10s egress spikes and validates no flip loops across 3 restarts. - Manual canary in staging for 48h, then 5% production canary for 2h before full rollout.

Rollout plan: Feature is gated behind a runtime feature flag (region_shed_coordinator_v2) and defaulted to ON for hotfix branches. After merging to main we rolled to canary (us-west-2 5%) then to global. The KV snapshot persistence uses existing encrypted KV and respects tenant data isolation.

Backward compatibility and impact: No external API changes. Behavioral changes are limited to internal load-shedding heuristics and are designed to reduce impact on tenants. Expected improvement: fewer circuit churn incidents, reduced tenant starvation during short transients, improved recovery behavior after restarts.

Related: ENG-9123 documents the incident and prior mitigation; SUP-4321 contains customer impact notes and follow-ups.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration harness tested - [x] Metrics and logs added - [x] Feature flag present - [x] Release notes drafted - [x] Canaries completed

Backport notes: This was applied as a hotfix branch and cherry-picked to the 2026-02-stable release branch (cherry-pick: b7f3c9a -> release/2026-02).

review_comments: Miguel Santos (reviewer): Can we make the probation TTL configurable per-region? I want to tune us-west separately during the next week of load tests.
Aisha Patel (author): Yes, made probation_ttl a helm value under routing.region.probation_ttl and added override for region-specific values in values.yaml.
Evelyn Park (reviewer): KV snapshot seems fine but we should bound total snapshot size. Add a fail-safe to avoid OOM on very large tenant counts.
Aisha Patel (author): Added snapshot size cap (default 1MB) and eviction fallback to in-memory hysteresis if exceeded. Documented in runtime/shed/kv_backoff_snapshot.go.
Tom Baker (reviewer): Integration harness passed locally, please include a short note on expected metric deltas so SREs know what to watch.
Aisha Patel (author): Added expected deltas to release notes and dashboards: small spike in circuit_probation_entries on rollout, eventual decrease in circuit flips.
Miguel Santos (approver): Approving after follow-up verification in staging.
